cohort: Pregnant women of both upper and lower socioeconomic status (SES) without major pregnancy complications were recruited and followed until delivery.
finding: The rate of LSCS, preterm birth, LBW, and NICU admission was higher among the lower SES group compared to the upper SES group, with NICU admission having a statistically significant association with SES (p=0.038).
birth_weight: LBW babies were included as an outcome
